monitored_text: Anodized CNC Aluminum 6061-T3 Parts Milling Services Color anodized CNC milling aluminum 6061-T3 machine component fabricated with Junying precision milling services . 6061 aluminum is a precipitation-hardened alloy that is made up of magnesium and silicon as primary alloying elements, exhibits good mechanical properties, good weldability, and good extrusion performance. Aluminum 6061-T3 is one of its tempered grades, which include more common alloy 61s 6061-T6. Our Computer Numerical Control milled aluminum parts are widely used in a diversity of machines, machinery, equipment, instrument, and tools serve for machine tool, electronics, mechanical, medical, aerospace, automotive, food processing, and more industries. Not only quick turn and cost-effective milling services, but various resources for material selection and tool setup are also provided in the CNCLATHING guide.
